Package index

Testing

Functions for testing a network statistic against random networks, networks with the same degrees, or permutations of the network, and for testing the parameters and the fit of a model:

test_gof() test_distributions()
Tests of model fit
test_random() test_configuration() test_permutation()
Tests of network measures
test_parameter() test_time()
Tests of a model's parameters

Specifying

The terms of an MRQAP formula and what each measures, the terms that suit a network, and functions for reading one formula for an MRQAP or an ERGM, and for seeing what each model makes of each term:

terms_mrqap
Terms of an MRQAP formula
formula(<specify_terms>) tidy(<specify_terms>)
The terms that suit a network
specify_mrqap() specify_ergm() tidy(<mrqap_formula>) tidy(<ergm_formula>)
Specify a model from a formula written for many models

Regressing

Functions for regressing a network on nodal and dyadic covariates by multiple regression quadratic assignment procedure (MRQAP), with random or fixed effects, missing data, panels, and cognitive social structures:

control_mrqap() print(<mrqap_control>)
Controls for an MRQAP
estimate_mrqap()
Regression for network data

Diffusing

Functions for simulating many diffusions on a network, to test a model of diffusion against:

play_diffusions() summary(<diffs_model>) print(<diffs_model>)
Simulating many diffusions

Diagnosing

Functions for diagnosing model results:

diagnose_confusion() print(<diagnose_confusion>) tidy(<diagnose_confusion>) glance(<diagnose_confusion>)
Diagnosing how well a model classifies ties
predict(<netreg>) predict(<netlm>) predict(<netlogit>)
Predicting from a network regression

Reporting

Functions for reporting and reading the results of regressions and tests, for tidying the results of other network models beside them, for predicting from a regression, and for diagnosing how well it classifies ties:

print(<netreg_lm>) print(<netreg_glm>) print(<netreg_css>) print(<netreg>) tidy(<netreg>) summary(<netreg>) print(<summary_netreg>) glance(<netreg>) glance(<netreg_lm>) glance(<netreg_glm>) glance(<netreg_css>) nobs(<netreg>) logLik(<netreg>) deviance(<netreg>) fitted(<netreg>) residuals(<netreg>) formula(<netreg>) terms(<netreg>)
Reporting network regression results
tidy(<network_test>) glance(<network_test>) print(<network_test>)
Reporting network test results
tidy(<netlm>) tidy(<netlogit>) glance(<netlm>) glance(<netlogit>) print(<netlm>) print(<netlogit>) tidy(<ergm>) glance(<ergm>) tidy(<sienaFit>) glance(<sienaFit>)
Tidying the results of other network models
